title: Spider-Gwen #1 2015 Francesco Francavilla Kirby Monster Variant Marvel
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Spider-Gwen #1 (April 2015), Marvel Comics - Francesco Francavilla "after Kirby" Monster Variant Edition. Written by Jason Latour, art by Robbi Rodriguez. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Hasbro Avengers: Age of Ultron Hero Gear ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
